title: Common Tax and Accounting Mistakes Denturists Make in Canada

rows.section: Denturist Business Taxes: Overview (Corporate Income Tax bullet)
rows.before: Active business income gets the small business deduction under section 125 on the first $500,000, which in Ontario is roughly 12.2% against 26.5% above it.
rows.after: Active business income gets the small business deduction under section 125 on the first $500,000, which in Ontario is roughly 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) against 26.5% above it.
rows.note: 12.2% stated as current combined Ontario small business rate; 11.2% from July 1, 2026. First R1 change on page: parenthetical added.

page_note: All 12.2% occurrences are current-rate R1. No 3.2%, 0.122/0.032, $600,000/$600K or 12.2%-derived dollar figures found. No 12.2% in this post's JSON-LD.
